features.name: Joker types
features.description: Hand, global and Triple Trouble multipliers.

review:
Deal With Death switches between two modes. Classic Mode is a normal payline slot, but Joker symbols trigger Poker Mode, turning every paying symbol into a playing card. Each row then plays as its own five-card poker hand and pays from a poker paytable.

The jokers do more than complete a hand: Hand Multiplier Jokers boost their row, Global Multiplier Jokers boost everything, and Triple Trouble Jokers reshuffle the cards to deal the three best hands possible. The cap is 20,000x. It's a refreshingly different idea, and fun if you know your poker hands.
